title: Workforce Education and Development, B.S. — Industrial Education Specialization (College of Education)
notes: Industrial Education specialization, University Park (of four: Industrial Education, Health Occupations Education, Occupational Home Economics Education, Industrial Training -- the bulletin's own plan assumes Industrial Education/Health Occupations, so those two share this structure). Program begins at any campus but ends at University Park; actively accepting students. The entire WFED department catalog was missing -- added minimal entries in new wfed_catalog.json. Real bug fixed: the bulletin's own suggested plan schedules WFED 441 (Year 2 Fall) before WFED 445 (Year 3 Spring), but WFED 441 strictly requires WFED 445 completed first (and WFED 445 itself requires WFED 105) -- reordered to WFED 105 -> WFED 445 -> WFED 441 -> WFED 442, the correct prerequisite order, rather than the bulletin's own listed (and internally contradictory) sequence. The repeated 'WFED 395A/B/C - Specialization' item (appearing 6 times across the plan, part of the 43-credit specialization total) is modeled as a generic slot each time, not a repeated literal course pick, since a completed course can't satisfy a second item in this engine and the specific A/B/C variant depends on the chosen track; re-verified 2026-08-26 that the live bulletin's Industrial Education table literally repeats 'WFED 395A' all six times (not A/B/C), confirming the plan's own placeholder approach is the right call. Real bug fixed 2026-08-26, corrected 2026-09-18: 'STS 245Z' does not exist in Penn State's current STS course catalog (bulletins.psu.edu/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/sts/ lists STS 245N but no 245Z, likely a stale bulletin typo) even though the live bulletin still literally prints 'STS 245Z/WFED 450' -- the 2026-08-26 fix removed 245Z but was overly conservative, dropping to 'WFED 450' as the sole option instead of substituting the real course it's a typo for, and it separately missed a second real option this same requirement has always had. Re-verified 2026-09-18 via a fresh live-bulletin fetch of bulletins.psu.edu/undergraduate/colleges/education/workforce-education-development-bs/: the Program Requirements table's 'Additional Courses: Select one of the following' entry (the same 3cr item the Suggested Academic Plan prints as 'STS 245Z or WFED 450' in Semester 7) actually lists three real, clickable-linked options -- LDT 100 (World Technologies and Learning, GS;IL Gen Ed, confirmed via bulletins.psu.edu/search/?P=LDT%20100 to be a live course with a full course-description block), STS 245Z (confirmed via bulletins.psu.edu/search/?P=STS%20245Z to return zero course results -- only an unrelated 'Using this Bulletin' help-page snippet that happens to cite 'STS 245Z' as a formatting example, proving 245Z is not a real current course), and WFED 450. Cross-checked bulletins.psu.edu/search/?P=STS%20245N, which returns a real course titled 'Globalization, Technology, and Ethics' -- the identical title the program page prints for its stale 'STS 245Z' -- confirming 245N is the current code for the same course (245Z was renamed/retitled to 245N at some point, matching the Z->N Gen Ed suffix migration WFED-2023.json's notes already documented for this exact course). Widened this item to ['LDT 100', 'STS 245N', 'WFED 450'], matching WFED-2023/2024/2025.json's own item for this same slot (each already modeled it this way and flagged in their own notes that WFED-2026.json's item was missing LDT 100 and should eventually be updated to match) -- WFED-2022.json alone differs, correctly using 'STS 245Z' instead of 245N for that older, pre-rename catalog year. LDT and STS are not in this plan's 'departments' list and neither has a dedicated LDT catalog file (STS does: catalogs/sts_catalog.json, which already carries STS 245N) -- left this as-is rather than adding department/catalog scaffolding, since the historical years already established this same pattern (LDT 100/STS 245N as options without 'LDT'/'STS' in their own departments lists either) and build_full_plan still resolves the item cleanly to 'WFED 450' with zero warnings and goal met, exactly like this file. Real bug fixed: 'Health/Physical Activity' (x2) were left as unwired generic placeholders despite being the exact same real GHW Gen Ed requirement wired everywhere else in this college's plans -- wired both to gen_ed GHW. 'Literature Selection' is now wired via `match` to the same real college-wide Literature Selection course list used by Elementary and Early Childhood Education (the live bulletin's own footnote points to the identical ed.psu.edu URL). 'Science Selection' (x3), 'Humanities Selection', 'Mathematics Selection' (x2), 'Social/Behavioral Science Selection', 'Art Selection' (x2), and generic 'Elective' pools plausibly correspond to this college's standard Gen Ed domains (GN/GH/GQ/GS/GA) given the credit totals line up exactly (Mathematics Selection x2 = 6cr = the real GQ requirement, with no other MATH item anywhere in this plan), but no citation ties WFED's bare, un-prefixed labels to a specific domain the way this college's other majors' 'GEN ED (...)' -prefixed labels do -- left generic per the 'never fabricate' rule rather than guess.
